ideas.pitch: An AI-powered logistics routing engine that optimizes multi-modal freight transport for minimal carbon emissions and maximum fuel efficiency in real-time.
ideas.problem_statement: Supply chain optimization and last-mile delivery innovations with a focus on efficiency and sustainability
ideas.title: EcoRoute AI: Dynamic Carbon-Aware Freight Dispatch
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly addresses the hackathon's core stated focus on sustainability and supply chain optimization for logistics judges.

ideas.pitch: A real-time edge computer vision dashboard that tracks container movement bottlenecks, equipment dwell times, and yard congestion anomalies from CCTV feeds.
ideas.problem_statement: Developing innovative solutions addressing key logistics challenges with a focus on efficiency
ideas.title: PortPulse: Computer Vision Container Yard Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates hard engineering in computer vision applied directly to a classic, highly visible port and terminal logistics bottleneck.

ideas.pitch: An offline-first mobile web app for last-mile delivery drivers in low-connectivity urban zones that synchronizes proof-of-delivery and reroutes via peer-to-peer device mesh.
ideas.problem_statement: Last-mile delivery innovations and technology-driven solutions for urban logistics
ideas.title: LastMile Mesh: Offline-First Delivery P2P Sync
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a genuine, highly relatable operational pain point for Indian urban last-mile delivery agents experiencing spotty network coverage.

ideas.pitch: A simulated IoT telemetry platform that predicts perishable food and pharmaceutical spoilage risks during transit using live environmental sensor inputs and ML regression.
ideas.problem_statement: Technology-driven solutions for supply chain integrity and reducing spoilage in transit
ideas.title: ColdChain Guard: IoT Predictive Temperature Risk Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines practical IoT data simulation with actionable risk-mitigation insights that industry mentors and judges care deeply about.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent triage platform for reverse logistics that automates return item disposition, refurbishment scoring, and secondary market routing to minimize waste.
ideas.problem_statement: Supply chain optimization, sustainability, and social impact in logistics
ideas.title: ReverseFlow: Circular Supply Chain Return Router
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on reverse logistics, an often-overlooked sector of the supply chain that offers massive untapped cost-saving potential for enterprises.
